# The New Life Performance Modpack
The New Life Performance Modpack is crafted to enhance the Minecraft experience, particularly for players on the The New Life SMP server, while remaining fully compatible with other vanilla servers. This pack is designed for maximum performance, integrate proximity voice chat via Simple Voice Chat for immersive multiplayer interactions, and ensure seamless gameplay compatibility with the The New Life server.

**Here are some of the key mods included:**

- Sodium, Lithium & FerriteCore – Significantly improve FPS, reduce memory usage, and optimize game performance.
- ImmediatelyFast & BadOptimizations – Provide additional rendering and client-side performance enhancements.
- Concurrent Chunk Management Engine (C2ME) – Improves chunk loading and world generation performance for faster gameplay.
- EntityCulling & More Culling – Prevent unnecessary rendering of hidden entities and blocks, helping increase frame rates.
- Very Many Players – Optimizes multiplayer performance and reduces lag on larger servers.
- Dynamic FPS – Lowers resource usage when Minecraft is running in the background.
- Simple Voice Chat – Enables seamless proximity voice communication with other players on the server.
- Zoomify – Adds a customizable zoom feature for exploring, building, and taking screenshots.
